Leave gravity at the door. Inside these walls the only weight that matters is the one you choose to lift. Show up, put in the work, respect the room, and let consistency do the rest.

Three zones.
One standard.

Scroll sideways through the floor.

Cardio

Treadmills, cross trainer and bikes facing a wall of daylight. Sessions on the treadmill are capped at 15 minutes so everyone gets a turn.

Free weights

Adjustable benches, racks, barbells and a full dumbbell rack on shock-absorbing rubber flooring.

Machines

Plate-loaded and cable stations in white and black, laid out with room to move between them.

Open floor

Wood-look flooring, ceiling fans and space for mobility work and stretching.

Gravity off

Weights float.
Results don't.

Keep scrolling and gravity switches back on. Every plate finds its rack.

Train hard. Respect the room.

  • Carry a towel and wipe equipment after use.
  • Return every weight to its place.
  • Keep treadmill sessions to 15 minutes.
  • Tell your trainer straight away if you feel pain.
  • Follow trainer instructions for safety.

Before you walk in

What should I bring?

A towel. The club asks every member to carry one while training.

How long can I use a treadmill?

Up to 15 minutes at a time, so everyone gets a turn.

What if I feel pain or get injured?

Tell your trainer straight away and follow their instructions.

Is my stuff safe?

Management is not responsible for lost personal items, so keep valuables with you.
